messages:
Asha: dropping a new take on the version history: a horizontal 'version carousel' that compresses dense histories and surfaces rollout controls inline. figma: https://www.figma.com/file/carousel/v1 (page: carousel-compact)

Asha: main asks: copy for inline actions (restore vs rollback), keyboard nav, and how to show A/B variants in a tight row.

Diego: nice visual. question: how does focus work when carousel items overflow? must allow arrow navigation and PageUp/PageDown for larger jumps.

Maya: agree on keys. also recommend skip-to-recent shortcut. keyboard users shouldn't have to arrow through 100 items.

Omar: copy nit: swap "Rollback" -> "Restore" for main CTA. less scary. For experiments add a secondary action "Pause variant".

Sofie: accessibility: carousel should be role=carousel or role=list with aria-roledescription="version carousel" and each item role=option. announce index like "Version v5 of 48" on focus.

Asha: nice. what about microcopy for inline mini-confirm? small inline confirm toast vs full modal?

Diego: rule idea: inline undo toast for <20% traffic or single-region changes. show modal when change affects >20% traffic / multiple regions. modal should state exact traffic change.

Maya: modal copy suggestion: header: "Restore version v2.7.0?" body: "This will route 100% of new traffic to v2.7.0. Ongoing requests will continue on current version.\nIf this is a canary restore, specify percent: X% will be routed immediately." confirm CTA: "Restore" secondary: "Cancel"

Omar: add aria for the modal confirm: e.g., <div role="dialog" aria-labelledby="restore-title" aria-modal="true">... and add aria-live polite "Restore started: routing 10% to v2.7.0" when it begins.

Sofie: badges: we need label + color combos that meet AA at 12px. current blue-on-white fails. propose darker tints and an optional outline. Also provide sr-only text for icons.

Diego: A/B variants: show small tag "Variant A" / "Baseline" and a tiny delta badge ("+3.2%"). if traffic <3% show dot+tooltip. no full bars.

Maya: performance: carousel virtualization is required. expanded detail overlays should be anchored and kept mounted if focused. spike RED-3501 for perf validation.

DeployBot: ticket created RED-3501: "Version carousel: virtualization, keyboard nav, modal ARIA, badge contrast" https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/RED-3501

Asha: thanks all 64f action items: change copy to "Restore", add keybinding table (Arrows, PageUp/PageDown, Home/End, Skip to recent), modal ARIA + aria-live strings, contrast fixes, and perf spike. i'll update figma and reupload.

Omar: one tiny extra: add undo in-app for 30s after restore (toast with "Undo restore") so PMs can quickly revert without modal.

Sofie: add note to docs: screen reader text examples and aria-roledescription. i'll draft the snippet in the PR.

Asha: great, i'll ping when updated. :sparkles:
